proposed_widenings.name: TargetSelection.mode = "any_number"
proposed_widenings.justification: Beacon of Hope targets 'any number of creatures within range' with no numeric cap. The existing TargetSelection modes are 'one' (single target) and 'choose_up_to' with a SlotScaling<number> count. Neither honestly represents an uncapped open selection. Coercing to choose_up_to with a large base number would be false — the SRD imposes no limit.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose any number of creatures within range.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation kind = "roll_advantage"
proposed_widenings.justification: Beacon of Hope grants ongoing advantage on Wisdom saving throws (and Death Saving Throws) to each target for the duration. OngoingOperation only supports 'roll_modifier' (numeric DiceDelta, as in Bless) and 'damage_on_hit'. There is no variant for granting advantage as a persistent ongoing operation. The v4 atom modify_roll_advantage exists and is used in mastery effects, but it is not reachable from OngoingOperation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: each target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation kind = "maximize_healing_received"
proposed_widenings.justification: Beacon of Hope causes each target to regain the maximum number of HP from any healing for the duration. This is a passive modifier on incoming healing — not a roll_modifier (numeric addend) and not a damage_on_hit rider. The closest v4 atom is modify_roll_substitute (substitute die results with maximum value), but no OngoingOperation variant exists to express 'while this spell persists, substitute healing dice results with their maximum on this attachment.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing

notes: All three widening pressures are surface gaps (missing variants of existing types), not structural mismatches or unknown atoms. The family ongoing_effect is the correct and honest fit. The v4 atom inventory already contains modify_roll_advantage and modify_roll_substitute, so items 2 and 3 above are purely OngoingOperation variant additions. Item 1 requires a new TargetSelection mode. No dhall/json/trace produced because the unit cannot be encoded honestly without these three additions.
